title.narrative: Providing 500 temporary housing units for those affected by the earthquake in the city of Mare’ in the countryside of Aleppo Governorate.

description.narrative: Replacing the canvas tents of earthquake victims in 6 camps by providing 501 temporary housing caravans for 400 families, including a bathroom and a kitchen attached to the unit, supplying the temporary housing units with electricity through solar energy systems and providing heating tools, and providing basic furniture in the housing units.
Sheltering (400) families affected by the earthquake by providing (501) temporary housing units furnished with the necessary equipment to provide them with decent and safe shelter.

The project aims to replace the worn-out canvas tents of families affected by the earthquake in the city of Mare’ in the countryside of Aleppo Governorate in the Syrian Arab Republic, who are located in (6) separate camps designated for the displaced, with (501) temporary mobile housing units, fully furnished and equipped with a bathroom and kitchen annex, and to provide a source of electrical energy to provide them with safe and decent shelter.
